answer:
Generate a starting structure for BiFeO3 in the R3c space group (No. 161) as the rhombohedral primitive cell containing 10 atoms (2 Bi, 2 Fe, 6 O), with lattice parameters a = b = c = 3.96 Angstrom and alpha = beta = gamma = 59.0 degrees, placing Bi and Fe on the 6a Wyckoff positions and O on the 18c Wyckoff positions scaled to the primitive cell.
Use LDA pseudopotentials from PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard: bi.upf, fe.upf, and o.upf.
Set the wavefunction energy cutoff ecutwfc to 60 Ry.
Set the charge-density cutoff ecutrho to 4 times ecutwfc (240 Ry).
Use an automatic 4x4x4 Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift.
Set etot_conv_thr to 1.0e-8, forc_conv_thr to 1.0e-7, and conv_thr to 1.0e-8.
Perform a variable-cell relaxation (vc-relax) on the starting structure, allowing all cell parameters and atomic positions to relax.
After the vc-relax converges, run a self-consistent field (SCF) calculation on the fully relaxed structure using identical pseudopotentials, ecutwfc, ecutrho, k-point grid, and convergence thresholds.
Return the fully relaxed atomic coordinates and cell vectors from the vc-relax step.
Return the final total energy from the SCF calculation on the relaxed structure.
